capabilities: Open and focus a PTY-backed terminal pane
Create, split, and switch between multiple terminal sessions
Add custom shell profiles with executable and arguments
Detect installed shells from the environment
Run sessions detached from closed panes and reconnect
disambiguation: Not a shell command runner or task executor; it embeds a full interactive terminal in the workspace.
extras: README carries a security warning that the shell runs with Obsidian's permissions and can access or modify files anywhere the user can. Not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff. Only local filesystem vaults are supported; no mobile or musl-based Linux.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, so users must switch to an external app to run shell commands alongside their notes.
summary: PTY-backed terminal plugin that opens real shell sessions in a dockable Obsidian pane, with splits, session management, and custom shell profiles.
